decision: fork kind bar instead of a companion overlay
why: overflow has to own layout and drag. flush-bar only watches config

decision: same PanelWindow second row, not a second layer surface
why: moduleDropAtScene discards pointers outside the source contentItem

decision: overflow flag on the layout entry, not a fourth region
why: keeps left/center/right and matches inline widget settings

decision: treat overflow flips as structural in inlineSettingsDelta
why: same ids in the same order would otherwise skip a rebuild

decision: IpcHandler target dmalmq.omastow, not shell call
why: callIfLoaded only has panel overlay menu loaders

decision: copy packaged bar, do not clone omarchy.bar for publish
why: clone id and clonedFrom are not the marketplace contract. required-property clone bugs

decision: expect media to work through PluginFirstPartyServiceApi
why: kind bar gets proxies for idle media nightlight notifications

decision: dmalmq.omabar is the active bar
why: plugin enable plus restart left namespace omarchy-bar at 2400x24 with the same widgets

decision: keep IpcHandler target omarchy.bar for omarchy-toggle-bar
why: toggle parked the live layer at y=-24 then restored y=0 even with a duplicate-handler warn

decision: media playback not proven on this session
why: no MPRIS names on the session bus. playerctl missing. widget is visible only when hasMedia

decision: power panel summon is a gap
why: shell summon omarchy.power returned ok. no extra overlay layer. audio network bluetooth panels opened

decision: inset strip for expanded, stock bar plus down chevron for collapsed
why: flush reads as a taller bar. cluster is a poor drop target. tokens from live Aether bar

decision: same-bar drawer as default, apps and plugins in one chevron
why: tray already collapses StatusNotifier items. plugins cannot join it. user wants that menu, not a second strip

decision: overlay local Tray.qml for omarchy.tray
why: configureBar gives a third-party bar publicBarWidgetSnapshot of the host registry. widgets/Tray.manifest.json is not a scanned plugin

decision: name OmaStow, id dmalmq.omastow
why: OmaBar Drawer already listed as io.github.amitcpatel.omabar-drawer

decision: shared overflowExpanded latch, per-drawer hoverHeld
why: click and IPC open every monitor. a shared hover bool would collapse the still-hovered copy when the pointer leaves another
evidence: Bar.qml OverflowDrawer open OR, BarPanel barHoverCount

decision: BarModel.moveModule owns the overflow bit; drawer chrome is the first-drop sink
why: QML splice could not assert the flag in node. empty moduleName appends in the source section so a first drop has a target before any overflowed plugin exists

decision: resolve the tray widget per bar surface, not one shared trayHostItem
why: one pointer was overwritten by every monitor copy and nulled when that monitor left. drawer reads the tray slot in its own window via sameWindow

decision: a popout on an overflow slot holds the drawer open and skips the slide
why: PopupCard anchors once at show. summon on a collapsed drawer anchored under the reserved gap. instant reveal puts the icon in place before the anchor

decision: drawer-chrome drop resolves by edge, not by source section
why: appending in the source section landed the widget wherever that section fell in the left center right walk, not where the marker sat

decision: mirror drawer geometry when docked on the left section
why: right-dock offsets left a drawer-width gap before a left-docked chevron and slid it toward the modules
